sections.label: Venue hire subsidy extension
sections.summary: The venue hire subsidy of 80% will be extended for another three months, from April to June 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Furthermore, we will extend the venue hire subsidy of 80% for another three months, from April to June 2021.

sections.label: ACRP additional $20 million
sections.summary: The ACRP will be further enhanced with an additional $20 million this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The ACRP will be further enhanced with an additional $20 million this year.

sections.label: New grant for SEPs
sections.summary: A new Grant will be rolled out by June 2021, allowing SEPs and collaborating organisations to apply for up to $50,000 per project.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: We are also deeply aware of the uncertainty that the COVID-19 pandemic had caused for the self-employed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Therefore, a new Grant will be rolled out by June 2021, allowing the SEP and organisations that collaborate with them to apply for a grant of up to $50,000 per project.

sections.label: Arts and Culture Digital Roadmap
sections.summary: MCCY will draw up an Arts and Culture Digital Roadmap in consultation with stakeholders to set the sector on a speedy digital track.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: To set the sector on a speedy digital track, MCCY will draw up an Arts and Culture Digital Roadmap in consultation with stakeholders.

sections.label: Museum visitorship and National Monuments
sections.summary: Museums drew close to 9.6 million visitors in 2019, and a commemorative exhibition will be held at the National Museum from June to September 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Before COVID-19, our museums achieved a record high visitorship of close to 9.6 million in the year 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: As Minister Edwin Tong has shared earlier, we are celebrating the 50th Anniversary of preserving our National Monuments this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: We will hold a special commemorative exhibition at the National Museum of Singapore from June to September 2021.

sections.label: Changi Chapel and Bukit Chandu reopening
sections.summary: Changi Chapel and Museum reopens in May 2021, and Reflections at Bukit Chandu reopens in the second half of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Changi Chapel and Museum, which documents and reveals the experiences of Prisoners of War and civilian internees, will re-open in May 2021, and Reflections at Bukit Chandu which commemorates the courage and resilience of the Malay Regiment in the Battle of Pasir Panjang, will reopen in the second half of 2021.

sections.label: Cultural Medallion Gallery at Arts House
sections.summary: MCCY will establish a dedicated Cultural Medallion Gallery at the Arts House at the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Miss Cheng Li Hui will be glad to know that MCCY will establish a dedicated Cultural Medallion Gallery to showcase the works of our talented Cultural Medallion winners in the Arts House at the end of this year.

sections.label: Arts spaces and sector recovery
sections.summary: The arts community agreed arts spaces should benefit more artists, and NAC is building diversified spaces while the sector pivots to digitalisation for recovery.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: In all these engagements, the arts community acknowledged that arts spaces should benefit more artists, especially new and upcoming talents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The importance of ensuring that our arts spaces benefit the wider community underpins NAC’s effort in building a pipeline of diversified spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: This is so that more practitioners can utilise multi-tenanted spaces for art making, capability development and audience engagement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: As we position the arts and culture sector for recovery, we will continue to safeguard livelihoods, retain and reinvigorate capabilities and talents – and with determination, pivot to new platforms with wider audiences through digitalisation.

sections.label: COVID-19 economic fallout on school leavers
sections.summary: A CNA article says the COVID-19 economic fallout affecting about 50,000 school leavers has led them to confront a grim reality.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: According to an article by CNA, the economic fallout resulting from the COVID-19 crisis affecting about 50,000 school leavers from the different tertiary institutions in Singapore and overseas has led them to confront a grim reality; a reality that might have been very different from the dreams that they had been pursuing just 18 months ago.

sections.label: Engaging youths in national concerns
sections.summary: The speaker asks MCCY to update on the effectiveness of youth engagement initiatives and what more will be done to engage youths from diverse backgrounds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: Chairman, our youths will inherit our future, and we should continue to engage them to participate and contribute actively to matters of our national concern that will also impact our society.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: Over the years, I understand that MCCY has announced several initiatives, such as the SG Youth Action Plan and Youth Action Challenge, to actively engage our youths and listen to their views.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: Can MCCY provide an update the effectiveness of these engagements and what else will be done to engage our youths from diverse backgrounds, so that they can partner with the Government and society to work on hot-button issues and issues that they care about, and to do so on a regular and sustainable basis?

sections.label: Family Assistance Fund applicants' income drop
sections.summary: A Beyond Social Services report found applicants' median household work income fell from $1,600 pre-COVID-19 to $500 post-COVID-19, a 69% drop.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: Beyond Social Services released a report in February this year which found that prior to COVID-19, the median household income of Family Assistant Funds applicants, derived from totalling work income in the household – was $1,600.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: Post-COVID-19, the median household income from work among applicants fell to $500 – a 69% drop.

sections.label: Youths, work and job-support initiatives
sections.summary: An MP asks the Minister for data on youths working while in school, initiatives to keep them in school, and take-up rates of job-support initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: In the worst case scenario, the youths may remain in menial roles or the unskilled gig economy, effectively perpetuating the poverty cycle.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: Therefore, I would like to ask the Minister if there is data about the number of youths who are working while still in school and if there are initiatives available to engage and encourage them to stay in school?

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: Would the Minister know what is the take-up rate for the different job-support initiatives among the low-income youths, and if the Ministry knows the reasons for such rates?

sections.label: SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package
sections.summary: The Government launched the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package last year and is enhancing it, including raising stipends for Diploma and ITE traineeships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Last year, our Government launched the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package to provide traineeship opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We are enhancing this package, including raising stipends for Diploma and ITE SGUnited Traineeship positions.

sections.label: NYC YouthTech Programme
sections.summary: NYC's YouthTech Programme will let up to 1,000 youths develop digital skills including content creation, digital marketing and data analytics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: As they do this, NYC is creating opportunities for them, such as through our YouthTech Programme, where up to 1,000 youths will develop digital skills, including content creation, digital marketing, and data analytics.

sections.label: Support for schooling youths who work
sections.summary: Schools identify and engage disengaged or at-risk students, offering academic, socio-emotional, after-school, community and financial support to keep them in school.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: And for schooling youths who need to work, schools proactively identify and engage students who are disengaged or at-risk to help keep them in school.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: There are academic, socio-emotional, after-school and community support, as well as financial support through MOE's Financial Assistance Scheme and school-based financial assistance.

sections.label: Youthopia visitor and page view figures
sections.summary: Youthopia has garnered over 480,000 visitors and 810,000 page views since its October launch.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Youthopia has garnered over 480,000 visitors and 810,000 page views since we launched it in October.

sections.label: Youth YAC projects helping vulnerable
sections.summary: Youths have started 16 YAC projects focused on helping vulnerable groups, including those affected by COVID-19, seniors and persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Our youths have started 16 YAC projects focused on helping our vulnerable, including families or individuals heavily affected by COVID-19, seniors as well as persons with disabilities (PwDs).

sections.label: Youth Circle Good Samaritan Law report
sections.summary: A Youth Circle will submit a report on a possible Good Samaritan Law promoting food redistribution for MSE to consider in future legislative changes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: This is aligned, of course, with our SG Green Plan 2030 to reduce waste and pursue sustainable living.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: This month, this Youth Circle will submit a report on a possible Good Samaritan Law that promotes food redistribution, for MSE to consider in future legislative changes.

sections.label: Singapore Together Alliances for Action set up
sections.summary: The Singapore Together Alliances for Action were set up for people to be involved, as Minister Edwin mentioned.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: As Minister Edwin mentioned, we have set up the Singapore Together Alliances for Action (SG Together AfA) for our people to be involved.

sections.label: AfA on Corporate Purpose launch
sections.summary: The SG Together AfA on Corporate Purpose will be launched to work with private sector companies and partners on a National Blueprint and Framework on Corporate Purpose.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Second, we will launch the SG Together AfA on Corporate Purpose, to work with private sector companies and partners on a National Blueprint and Framework on Corporate Purpose.

sections.label: Two new AfA announced by MCCY
sections.summary: MCCY will announce two new Singapore Together Alliances for Action, the first on emerging needs and volunteerism, partnering citizens, communities and businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   MCCY is committed to working with Singaporeans to build a caring and cohesive society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: This year, we will announce two new Singapore Together Alliances for Action (AfA), where we will continue to spur on the spirit of care and giving in society, by partnering our citizens, communities and businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: The first is on emerging needs and volunteerism, to enhance support for mental wellness, provide space and opportunities for seniors to learn innovatively, and facilitate the matching and giving of donations-in-kind more effectively.

sections.label: Museum submissions and Founders' Memorial call
sections.summary: The National Museum has received about 200 online submissions, and NHB will launch a public call for artefacts and stories related to Singapore's milestones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: To-date, the National Museum has received about 200 online submissions and it will focus on different themes over the next few years, to encourage Singaporeans to contribute objects that best represent life in Singapore in recent times.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: And as part of the development of the Founders' Memorial, our National Heritage Board (NHB) will also launch a public call in the third quarter of this year, for artefacts and stories related to key milestones in Singapore's Independence, history and founding values.

sections.label: Sports industry JSS tier upgrade
sections.summary: The speaker asks MCCY to consider upgrading the sports and fitness industry from tier 3 to Tier 2 for JSS support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Because of this, I would like MCCY to consider upgrading the sports and fitness industry from tier 3 to Tier 2 for JSS support.

sections.label: E-sports viewership and Asian Games
sections.summary: The League of Legends World Championships in Shanghai drew over 46 million viewers, and the Olympic Council of Asia confirmed e-sports as a full medal event at the 2022 Asian Games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: For instance, the League of Legends World Championships held in Shanghai in late 2020, drew more than 46 million viewers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Recently, the Olympic Council of Asia confirmed that the Asian Games would offer a programme where e-sports has its place as a full medal event in 2022.

sections.label: E-sports event spending forecast
sections.summary: Top e-sports events in Singapore are expected to spend at least $30 million in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Looking ahead, top e-sports events in Singapore are expected to spend at least $30 million in 2021.

sections.label: Tencent joins GEF, regional hub
sections.summary: Tencent's leadership joined the GEF as its first partner and established its regional hub in Singapore less than a year later.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: The vision of Tencent's leadership saw them join the GEF as its very first partner and, in less than a year later, to establish its regional hub right here in Singapore.

sections.label: Hosting annual Global Esports Games
sections.summary: The speaker says they intend to host the annual Global Esports Games in December 2021 and every year after.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: The possibilities are boundless if we seize the opportunities we have been given and which we helped create.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: We intend to host the annual Global Esports Games in December 2021 and every year after that.

sections.label: Athlete incentive and retirement programmes
sections.summary: Major Games Award Programme incentives from the 1990s do not confer retrospective recognition, and no system keeps retired athletes engaged save for Olympians Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Incentive programmes such as the Major Games Award Programme were established in the 1990s, which do not confer retrospective recognition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Currently, there is no system to help keep retired athletes engaged in the national programmes, save for Olympians Singapore.

sections.label: ActiveSG booking resale suspensions
sections.summary: Media reports said social footballers paid $240 to $300, a reseller profited $180, and SportSG suspended 255 ActiveSG accounts for reselling bookings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: A Straits Times article dated 1 February 2021 reported social footballers had to fork out between $240 and $300 in order to play.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: In another media report, it was said that the reseller is making a profit of $180.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: A follow-up media report dated 15 February 2021 mentioned that 255 ActiveSG accounts guilty of reselling bookings have been suspended by SportSG.

sections.label: Charities digitalisation support initiatives
sections.summary: The Commissioner of Charities launched initiatives including the VWOs-Charities Capability Fund to enhance charities' online management capabilities and operational efficiency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
sentences.text: Last year, the Commissioner of Charities launched various initiatives to support our charities in accelerating and strengthening their digitalisation process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
sentences.text: This includes the VWOs-Charities Capability Fund, known as VCF, that aims to enhance the online management capabilities and operational efficiency of charities.

sections.label: Budget breakdown and comparison
sections.summary: The $796 million budget has $207 million for development and $589 million for operating expenditure, which includes manpower and other operating costs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Its $796 million budget comprises a $207 million development budget – mainly to build and upgrade community clubs – and the remaining $589 million for operating expenditure.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: It is, however, not very meaningful, as a Member suggested, to compare operating budget to headcounts as $589 million includes both manpower as well as other operating expenditure.

sections.label: Technology hub for non-profits
sections.summary: MCCY, Tote Board and NCSS are developing a technology hub for non-profit organisations offering funding and ICT consultancy services, targeted for July.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: MCCY is working together with the Tote Board and NCSS, to develop a first-ever technology hub for non-profit organisations to accelerate the sector’s digital transformation.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: As a one-stop-shop for key Info-Communication Technology (ICT) services, this technology hub for NPOs will avail funding and ICT consultancy services to charities from the “Arts and Heritage”, “Community”, “Education”, “Health”, “Sports” and “Others” sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: This is over and above support provided by the NCSS under the Tech-and-Go! initiative, and we hope to make this available by July this year.

sections.label: SRP Operating Grant extension
sections.summary: Close to 100 businesses benefited from the SRP Operating Grant, and SportSG will extend it from April to December 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: To-date, close to 100 businesses have benefited from an Operating Grant under the SRP that covers up to 25% of their total operating expenses, capped at $15,000 per month, for up to six months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: To provide short-term financial support to critical sports businesses, SportSG will extend the SRP Operating Grant from April to December 2021.

sections.label: Mentorship allowances and grant extension
sections.summary: Mentees receive $400 monthly and mentors $600 monthly for six months, and the Enterprise Innovation and Capability Development Grant will be extended.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Under this programme, mentees will receive a monthly allowance of $400, and mentors, $600 monthly, for six months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: We will also extend the Enterprise Innovation and Capability Development Grant that was launched in June last year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: It will cover 70% of qualifying costs capped at $180,000.

sections.label: Project team sport SEP requirement
sections.summary: Project teams must include at least one sport SEP registered with organisations such as NROC or ActiveSG.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Project teams must comprise at least one sport SEP registered with organisations, such as NROC or ActiveSG.

sections.label: SportSG Computer Vision Systems rollout
sections.summary: SportSG will roll out Computer Vision Systems using video technology to better analyse an athlete's performance.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: SportSG will also roll out a series of Computer Vision Systems that leverages video technology to better analyse an athlete’s performance.

sections.label: Football participation base and youth pathways
sections.summary: MCCY and MOE will build a participation base, engage Secondary schools to establish SFAs, and provide scholarships for top youth talents.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: MCCY will work with MOE to build up a robust participation base, with about 2,000 boys per primary school cohort exposed to football techniques and tactics under FAS's national curriculum.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: This is an inclusive vision, a very timely one, given today is 8 March, International Women's Day, as we also want to grow the participation base for women's football.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: We will be engaging Secondary schools to invite them to establish School Football Associations, or SFAs, where aspiring footballers can further develop their skills in a school-based training environment, supported by an augmented coaching bench, enhanced facilities and an intensive training programme.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Youth footballers under the SFAs will compete in an elite youth league to hone their competitive edge.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: For those who wish to pursue a professional career in football, local and overseas scholarships will be provided for our top youth talents.

sections.label: MCCY MINDEF support for footballers
sections.summary: MCCY is working with MINDEF on support avenues for eligible footballers, including early enlistment, leave and time-off for NSFs to train.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: MCCY is working with MINDEF to tap support avenues for eligible footballers, including early enlistment, leave and time-off for NSFs to train, as well as opportunities to continue training and playing at the very top levels while fulfilling their NS obligations.

sections.label: Value of artist-managed art centres
sections.summary: The first clarification asks whether the Government agrees there is value in art centres being managed by artists rather than all being Government-run.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: The first clarification is whether the Government actually agrees that there is value in art centres being managed by artists rather than all being Government-run as these would add to the richness of the eco-system and also make the arts authentic and sustainable.

sections.label: Artist-managed centres and The Substation
sections.summary: The question asks whether a centre managed by artists cannot also accommodate many users, citing The Substation and feedback about decisions already made.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: My question is, does she not agree that there is actually no reason why a centre managed by artists cannot also accommodate many users in that sense?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: In fact, the current concern and dismay about the status of The Substation is a case in point, because many budding artists actually got their first breaks or were incubated in this artist-managed space called The Substation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: Some of us have received feedback, that although there were sessions indeed, but the feeling was that decisions had already been made regarding certain spaces; there was no advanced information about what would happen.

sections.label: Arts Gross Floor Area growth
sections.summary: Total arts Gross Floor Area grew to 88,000 sqm in 2020, with NAC facilitating 6,500 sqm more from private sector initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Over the years, our total Gross Floor Area, or GFA, for the arts have grown steadily to 88,000 sqm in the year 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: NAC has also facilitated diversification of art space, primarily in private sector, which has also added 6,500 sqm GFA for arts through initiatives like the Community Sports Facilities Scheme and so on.

sections.label: 45 Armenian Street arts space intent
sections.summary: MCCY and NAC intend 45 Armenian Street to remain an inclusive, multi-disciplinary arts space, with grants rolled out by June.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In the interest of time, Chairman, details of the engagements are publicly available in NAC's statements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to reiterate that it has always been the intent of MCCY and NAC for 45 Armenian Street to remain an inclusive, multi-disciplinary arts space, a safe space for artistic experimentation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to reassure everyone in this House that MCCY, NAC and the staff will continue to involve and consult our various stakeholders whether in administering grants, or supporting our community with infrastructure and space.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: That is why Minister Edwin Tong and myself, in our earlier speeches, mentioned that the SEP grant and the Business Transformation Grant will be rolled out by June because we do not want to rush the process.

sections.label: 45 Armenian Street renovation and Substation
sections.summary: The renovation aims to let more emerging arts groups share the space, with The Substation returning as a multi-tenanted option.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The intention behind this renovation of 45 Armenian Street is precisely to allow more, newer, emerging, younger arts groups to come and share the space.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: They were aware that the space was to be renovated, having been in the premises for the past 30 years as a Major Company.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: They were aware also that interim spaces were offered, such as Goodman Arts Centre, for the two years that The Substation will be renovated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And additional financial support would also be given to The Substation whilst they spend two years away from Armenian Street.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In the period of time that we have looked at in the last couple of years, at the very minimum, the majority of uses or usage of The Substation was not by The Substation, was by third party users.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, taking that into account, amongst others, the view was taken that he arts community will be better served if The Substation, post-renovation, will return as a multi-tenanted option.
